what: South Atlantic Albacore Management Strategy Evaluation
title: South Atlantic Albacore Management Strategy Evaluation
text: iccatSALB R package supporting Management Strategy Evaluation (MSE) South Atlantic albacore tuna, developed International Commission Conservation Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT). provides operating models, management procedures, performance metrics, related data code used evaluate candidate management procedures range plausible operating models stock fishery. See project homepage overview MSE materials, Trial Specifications Document full details operating models, management procedures, performance metrics used MSE.

title: South Atlantic Albacore Management Strategy Evaluation
text: can install iccatSALB package GitHub repository :

what: Build a legacy Data object with a combined abundance index — Build_Legacy_Data
title: Build a legacy Data object with a combined abundance index — Build_Legacy_Data
text: Converts `data` object (passed management procedure) legacy single-simulation `Data` class expected `DLMtool`/`SAMtool` management procedures, via [MSEtool::ConvertData()]. `Ind` slot (`CV_Ind`, `CV_Ind` supplied) overwritten using `index_fun`, multiple survey/CPUE series can folded single combined index rather relying [MSEtool::ConvertData()]'s default selecting single series.

title: Build a legacy Data object with a combined abundance index — Build_Legacy_Data
Build a legacy Data object with a combined abundance index — Build_Legacy_Data
text: Data `data` object, passed management procedure. index_fun Function taking `Data` returning named numeric vector combined index values (one per year), used overwrite converted object's `Ind` slot. CV_Ind Numeric. supplied, used constant CV combined index (assigned `Data@CV_Ind`); `NA` (default), `CV_Ind` left set [MSEtool::ConvertData()].

title: Build a legacy Data object with a combined abundance index — Build_Legacy_Data
text: legacy `Data` object (`nsim = 1`).

what: Build a reference operating model grid specification — Build_OM_Grid
title: Build a reference operating model grid specification — Build_OM_Grid
text: Creates `data.frame` enumerating grid growth (`g_levels`) x natural mortality (`m_levels`) scenarios SS3-based operating model conditioning. scenario combining median growth median M level flagged reference cell (`is_ref = TRUE`) pointed `ref_dir`, since assumed already exist (e.g. base stock assessment run) rather needing built.

title: Build a reference operating model grid specification — Build_OM_Grid
code: Build_OM_Grid(   g_levels = c(25, 50, 75),   m_levels = c(25, 50, 75),   ref_dir,   base_dir = "data-raw/assessment" )

title: Build a reference operating model grid specification — Build_OM_Grid
text: g_levels, m_levels Numeric vectors growth/natural-mortality scenario labels (e.g. `c(25, 50, 75)`), combined via [expand.grid()]. ref_dir Character. Path reference SS3 model directory, assigned reference grid cell's `run_dir`. base_dir Character. Base directory non-reference scenario run directories created.

title: Build a reference operating model grid specification — Build_OM_Grid
text: `data.frame` columns `g_scen`, `m_scen`, `om_name`,   `is_ref`, `run_dir`.

what: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
text: Bounds `NewTAC` within `+/- MaxChange` proportion `LastTAC`. `NewTAC` finite, `LastTAC` returned instead, warning recorded `Log`.

title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
text: NewTAC Numeric. Proposed TAC. LastTAC Numeric. Previous TAC; used fallback value base `MaxChange` cap. MaxChange Numeric. Maximum proportional change () permitted relative `LastTAC` (e.g. `0.4` allows -40%/+40%).

title: Cap the year-on-year change in a management procedure's TAC recommendation — Cap_TAC_Change
text: `list` elements `TAC` (capped TAC) `Log` (`NULL`,   warning message `NewTAC` non-finite).

what: Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
title: Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
text: Sets lambda (objective-function multiplier) applied named survey/CPUE index's likelihood contribution. explicit lambda row fleet/likelihood-component combination already exists `ctl$lambdas`, `value` overwritten; otherwise new row appended. Used build robustness operating models one index treated uninformative (`value = 0`) partially downweighted OM conditioning, data components left untouched.

title: Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
text: inputs list SS3 inputs returned [r4ss::SS_read()], containing `ctl` `dat` elements. index_name Character. Fleet name survey index downweight. value Numeric. Lambda value assign (default `0`). like_comp Integer. SS3 likelihood-component code survey/index data (default `1`). phase Integer. Phase lambda applies, used adding new row (default `1`).

title: Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
text: modified `inputs` list, updated `ctl$lambdas` table.

title: Set the likelihood weight (lambda) for a survey index in an SS3 control file — Downweight_Index
text: index name matched `dat$fleetinfo$fleetname` (`dat$fleetnames`, depending `r4ss` version) resolve numeric fleet code used lambda table.

what: Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey index — Downweight_Index_Grid
title: Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey index — Downweight_Index_Grid
text: Creates robustness counterpart existing OM grid (e.g. produced [Prepare_OM_Grid()]) copying cell's run directory setting lambda `index_name` `value` via [Downweight_Index()]. growth/M grid structure otherwise preserved, R1/R2-style robustness sets remain comparable cell--cell reference grid.

title: Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey index — Downweight_Index_Grid
Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey index — Downweight_Index_Grid
text: grid `data.frame` produced [Build_OM_Grid()] (typically [prepare_om_grid()] [run_ss3_grid()] run , `run_dir` points completed SS3 runs). index_name Character. Fleet name index downweight, passed [Downweight_Index()]. out_base_dir Character. Base directory robustness run directories created; cell's directory name taken `basename(grid$run_dir)`. value Numeric. Lambda value assign `index_name` (default `0`).

title: Build a robustness operating model grid by downweighting one survey index — Downweight_Index_Grid
text: `data.frame` like `grid`, `run_dir` updated new   robustness run directories.

what: Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects — Import_OM_Grid
title: Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects — Import_OM_Grid

title: Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects — Import_OM_Grid
Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects — Import_OM_Grid
text: grid `data.frame` columns `run_dir` `om_name`. out_dir Character. Directory save `.om` files ; created necessary. om_specs named list arguments passed [MSEtool::ImportSS()] (e.g. `Name`, `nSim`, `pYear`, `Agency`, `StockName`, `CommonName`, `Interval`, `DataLag`).

title: Import a grid of SS3 models into MSEtool operating model objects — Import_OM_Grid
text: Invisibly, character vector saved `.om` file paths.

what: Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control file — Modify_Growth_M
title: Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control file — Modify_Growth_M
text: Updates initial values von Bertalanffy growth parameters (`L_at_Amin`, `L_at_Amax`, `VonBert_K`) Lorenzen-scaled natural mortality parameter (`NatM_p_1`) SS3 control list, returned [r4ss::SS_read()]. Assumes single growth pattern / sex block (`Fem_GP_1`).

title: Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control file — Modify_Growth_M
Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control file — Modify_Growth_M
text: inputs list SS3 inputs returned [r4ss::SS_read()], containing `ctl$MG_parms`. Linf, K, t0 Numeric. Von Bertalanffy asymptotic length, growth coefficient, theoretical age zero length, used back-calculate `L_at_Amin` via `vonbert_L_at_Amin()`. M Numeric. Lorenzen-reference natural mortality scalar assigned `NatM_p_1_Fem_GP_1`.

title: Modify growth and natural mortality parameters in an SS3 control file — Modify_Growth_M
text: modified `inputs` list.

what: Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window — PM_Depletion_Min
title: Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window — PM_Depletion_Min
text: simulation, finds lowest annual spawning depletion (SB/SB0) reached `Years`. Unlike [MSEtool::PM_Safety()] (probability never falling limit), reports depletion level , natural (0-1) scale, `@Stat` (`Sim x Stock x MP`); average simulations e.g. `apply(result@Stat, c(2, 3), mean)`. `@Prob`/`@Mean` left `NA`, consistent natural-scale (non-probability) `PM_*` functions [MSEtool::PM_Yield()].

title: Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window — PM_Depletion_Min
Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window — PM_Depletion_Min
text: object `mse` object (list `mse` objects, combined via [MSEtool::CombineMSE()]). Years Numeric vector years evaluate . Default `NULL` uses [PM_Years()]. silent Logical. Suppress [MSEtool::CombineMSE()] summary message `object` `list`. Default `TRUE`.

title: Lowest depletion (SB/SB0) reached during a performance-metric window — PM_Depletion_Min
text: [MSEtool::pm-class] object.

title: Resolve a named performance-metric year window — PM_Window_Years

what: Restrict performance-metric years to those on/after an OM's MPStartYear — PM_Years
title: Restrict performance-metric years to those on/after an OM's MPStartYear — PM_Years
text: Performance metrics exclude projection years operating model's `MPStartYear` (interim-advice years, CMP actually set TAC). current [MSEtool::PM] functions, applied automatically (via internal `.FilterMPActiveYears()`) `Years` argument left `NULL` - calling e.g. [MSEtool::PM_Status()] [MSEtool::PM_Yield()] directly, `Years = NULL`, already excludes interim years, passing function's output redundant (though harmless - two floors idempotent).
